name: SopDocumentLifecycleManager
tagline: GMP SOPs from draft to effective – sign-offs, e-signed approval, training gate, periodic review and superseded versions in one app.
description: Complete controlled-document app for pharmaceutical quality teams. Route drafts to reviewers, collect e-signed sign-offs and approvals with four-eyes and QA rules, gate the effective date on read-and-understand training, plan periodic reviews per document type, start change-controlled revisions and supersede old versions automatically. Works in canvas apps, model-driven apps and Power Pages with demo data out of the box.
features: Reviewer sign-off routing with changes-required loop
E-signed approval with four-eyes and QA approver for GMP-critical documents
Training window and training target before the effective date
Periodic review intervals per document type with 12-month forecast
My tasks, late-step flags, reminders and master-list export
Bulk owner, reminders, export; undo; phone layout
controlType: standard (data-set control + Power Pages field control SopDocumentLifecycleManagerPortal)
